Looking for a job where you can stay active and work with fresh food? At Bonfait in Denekamp, we’re looking for motivated Production Workers who love to roll up their sleeves. Together with your team, you’ll help prepare and pack fresh ready-made meals, soups and salads for customers all over the Netherlands. 

No experience? No problem! If you’re eager to learn and ready to work, we’d love to meet you.

Wat wordt er van je verwacht
Every day is different, but the goal stays the same: making top-quality food that looks and tastes great. You’ll be part of a friendly, fast-paced team and we’ll show you everything you need to know.

Your tasks may include:
- Preparing fresh meals according to set recipes
- Assembling and decorating salads with fresh ingredients
- Filling trays and packages, getting everything ready for shipping
- Keeping your workspace clean and doing quality checks
- Working efficiently and keeping the team spirit high

You’ll work in 2 shifts:
- 06:00 AM – 2:45 PM
- 2:45 PM – 12:00 AM

Wat zoeken wij
We don’t ask for diplomas — we’re looking for energy, reliability and a hands-on attitude.
You are:
- Available full-time and willing to work 2 shifts
- Able to speak basic Dutch, English or German
- A team player who enjoys active work
- Precise and hygienic in your working style
- Motivated and not afraid to get your hands dirty

Wat bieden wij
- A starting salary of €15.61 per hour (excl. shift bonus)
- 133% shift bonus after 6:00 PM = €20.32 per hour
- Delicious Bonfait meals for just €2 each
- No transport? Use a 4 Minutes bike or scooter
- Growth opportunities within a fast-growing company

Over het bedrijf
Bonfait is a leading producer of fresh, ready-made meal solutions, located in Denekamp. With a passion for food and a strong focus on innovation, Bonfait delivers high-quality products to both retail and food service on a daily basis.
